# Products, brand and uptime {#sec-products}

::: {.callout-note}
## Being written
This chapter is part of the September 2026 revamp of the book (the plan is in
[CalCOFI/workflows](https://github.com/CalCOFI/workflows/tree/main/.claude/plans)) and lands in the
order the plan gives. What it will hold:

Every CalCOFI.io product with its section, its source, its uptime and its usage, generated from the landing page's cards; the three-slug contract that keeps a card, its monitor and its analytics one thing; the brand contract in one paragraph; and how to add a product.
